title: Tool for AI TDD in Unity
author: AgenticGameDev
selftext:
I’m just about to release my tool for unity game devs and needed a website. Be brutally honest and give me feedback.

I know there are about hundreds of AI tools out there. If you get my angle what do I need to make it clearer?

https://www.mooserunner.com

Don’t hold back.

comments.author: GigaTerra
comments.body:
>I know there are about hundreds of AI tools out there.

Exactly there is your problem, in the last 2 months I saw 5 AI automated test tools. So unless it has been an lifelong dream of yours to make an Automated test tool, so that you will work harder at this than any other person, and that you will spend the rest of your life making an perfect automated test tool even if the money is bad, I don't think there is an way to compete with volume. 

Because not only do you have to compete with what exists, but also others who like you will make AI tools.

Really if you want to make tools, focus on your dream tool.

replies.author: AgenticGameDev
replies.body:
Thank you! It has changed how I develop in Unity. It has been an internal tool fixing my frustrations as I did develop a B2B app.  
It’s not my long life dream. :)

Do you remember any name of them? I have not found any which is not QA focus. But that is the problems with search bubbles. I have the classical once like Unity Alttester, and some other QATools.

Once again thank you for the input! :)

replies.author: GigaTerra
replies.body: I don't remember their names, but just go check the history of the Unity3D sub. People posting assets have become so bad that I left that sub, every day there was like 3-4 new assets posted. There is also an official Unity sub for assets, check it as well.

comments.author: Varrianda
comments.body: Gonna be honest, why is this needed? If you’re already using agents just build a regression suite tailored to your game. I don’t have literal gherkin tests, but I have a bunch of tests that actually play the game and then report back if stuff failed(can’t turn in quest, can’t loot, combat broken, spells not working as expected…).

replies.author: AgenticGameDev
replies.body:
Cool. What framework? I have not had success in that form. In Unity I kept running in to state problems, and especially for multiplayer testing. Unitys built in testing is painful in my experience. What kind of game are you developing? Is it Unity?

So you let the agent drive the regression testing in an explatory way?
